tools.name: web.security-audit

tools.name: web.accessibility-audit

tools.name: web.full-audit

tools.name: web.business-due-diligence

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "developer.code-metrics" appears informational but accepts parameters (code) that enable code/file/secret access.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow.
